text:
zara: Quick sync for the release notes — targets for this docs deploy: migration guide (v0.9 -> v1.0), canonical streaming snippets, and a short Known Issues entry about embed streaming fallback. Need copy + CI fixes by Thursday.

jay: On it. I spotted a Python snippet using the legacy client.stream.generate API in PR #5123. Which PR should I push fixes to?

zara: Refer to #5123 (snippets/streaming-reorg). I left inline notes where the py example still uses `client.stream.generate()`.

miguel: I'll move the curl examples to the new /v1/streams endpoint and add a compact jq example for parsing chunked tokens. Proposed curl snippet:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"kestrel-1","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams | jq -r '.data.text'
```
This should help folks coming from the single-response flow.

elaine: Ran anchor-check on the feature branch and found two issues: migration.md references the old `#deployment-rollout` and there's an example id mismatch in snippets/streaming.md. Command I used: `./scripts/anchor-check --report=anchors.txt`

docs-bot: CI: docs-linkcheck triggered on PR #5123. Status: failed (2 broken anchors).

sam: I can add tiny frontmatter redirects to the migration doc to map the old rollout anchors to the new `#private-deploy` ones. Will keep redirects scoped so we don't change visible headers.

noa: Quick snippet note: let's standardize on `client.generate_stream()` across examples (py/js) and include a one-liner compatibility note for older SDKs: "If your SDK < 0.9.1, see compatibility section for `client.stream.*` mapping." Keeps docs consistent.

jay: Agreed. I'll standardize examples and push to #5130 (snippets/unify). I also will run the snippet unit locally to catch test regressions.

miguel: Small addition for migration guide: add a short cost note about batching. Draft line: "Server-side batching may reduce per-token cost under high throughput; dev curl examples show single-request behavior and won't trigger batching." Thoughts?

zara: Good call, @miguel. Add that under "Performance & Cost" in migration.md. Keep it brief.

elaine: After sam's redirect PR lands I will re-run anchor-check and re-trigger CI.

sam: Redirect patch created: PR #5131. Minimal frontmatter changes only.

docs-bot: PR #5130 (snippets/unify) CI: lint OK, snippet-tests failed (1 failing test). Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.test/5130/logs

jay: I'll take the failing snippet test tonight. If it's purely the API rename, I can update the test harness; if it's a runtime behavior change, we'll need to call that out in the relnotes.

noa: For the Known Issues blurb, propose: "Embed streaming may temporarily fall back to polling during capacity constraints; tokens can appear up to ~2s later. The system will automatically try to resume streaming when capacity is available." Short and customer-friendly.

zara: Perfect. I'll slot that into the relnotes under "Known Issues". Also add a short bullet: "Deprecated endpoint /v1/generate removed; use /v1/streams." Keep migration guidance top-level.

miguel: One last check: can someone validate the migration curl examples against staging so anchor IDs in examples match the built site? I can run a quick smoke build if someone approves.

elaine: I'll run a smoke build after redirects merge: `make site && ./scripts/anchor-check --fail-on=missing`. Will paste results here.

zara: Timeline: finish edits by Thursday EOD, final copy pass Friday morning, publish Friday 11:00 PT. Please ping this thread when PRs are green. Thanks all! :sparkles:
